title: Add offset jitter support
description:
Add optional jitter support to GroupMobility:
- Per-member offset jitter around their base offset position
- Configurable jitter magnitude and update frequency
- Smooth jitter transitions to avoid teleporting
- Maintain group cohesion while adding realistic variation
close_reason: Added optional per-member offset jitter to GroupMobility in python/src/lichen/sim/mobility.py: new constructor params jitter_m (default 0.0 = exact legacy behavior, zero RNG draws) and jitter_update_us (:241-242), validation in __post_init__ incl. combined group_radius_m+jitter_m bounds fit, _draw_jitter/:364 (uniform magnitude-angle within jitter_m), _update_jitter/:370 (retargets all members on the update timer, then glides each member toward its target at up to jitter_m per interval via _move_toward/:391 so transitions are smooth with no teleporting), and _place_members/:460 adds the bounded jitter displacement to the base ring offset. Center waypoints and initial clamp are inset by group_radius_m+jitter_m so cohesion and in-bounds guarantees hold. Tests: TestGroupMobilityJitter in python/tests/sim/test_group_mobility.py (9 tests) incl. a golden trajectory test with expected values generated from the pre-change implementation (git 4921cfd8f4) proving jitter-off identity, plus boundedness, smoothness rate bound, cohesion, in-bounds, determinism, validation, and update-frequency rate checks. Targeted suite 78 passed; full tests/sim/ 1610 passed, 36 skipped; ruff clean; mypy strict clean.
